recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core source change is needed for FHIR-12725 unless the unresolved FHIR-50074 discussion produces a new final work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-12725 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core issue asking for Reference.identifier documentation to clarify that the identifier need not point to an entity already available as a FHIR instance, but must point to a business concept that could be represented as an allowed FHIR resource type.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 11195. In git, aa10535dc9d24a7d13c079e83d1b1626f55010dd ('#12725 - note about use of Reference.identifier') added the requested clarification to source/datatypes/reference.xml and source/references.html.
additional_context: Reference is still an active normative datatype and references.html is in the build hierarchy. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-13694 refined the same scope rule to say the business concept can potentially be expressed as a FHIR resource, and that source fix is already on the combined branch. Later FHIR-50120 added canonical URL guidance without changing this rule. FHIR-50074 remains Triaged and does not constitute a final change decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already says Reference.identifier does not require an actual exposed FHIR instance and SHALL identify a business concept that can potentially be expressed as a permitted FHIR resource type.
